title: Change in Proportion of HDB Flats, Private Flats and Landed Properties
what_it_is: Change in Proportion of HDB Flats, Private Flats and Landed Properties

sections.label: HDB and private property proportions
sections.summary: Private properties rose from 243,000 to 372,000 units, cutting HDB's share of dwelling units from 78% to 73%, with HDB projected near 72% in 2020.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: The number of private properties, inclusive of landed properties, increased from 243,000 to 372,000 units.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Consequently, the proportion of HDB flats out of the total dwelling units in Singapore decreased from 78% to 73%, while the proportion of private properties increased from 22% to 27%.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Over the coming years, the proportion of HDB flats to non-HDB flats is projected to remain stable.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Lawrence Wong)
sentences.text: Our projections are that in 2020, the proportion of HDB flats out of the total dwelling units in Singapore will remain at around 72%.

sections.label: Public housing households and dwelling units
sections.summary: Households in public housing remain at 80%, while public housing dwelling units fell from 78% to 72% between 2006 and 2016 as private housing grew.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: The proportion of households who live in public housing remains at 80% today.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But the physical dwelling units, as I mentioned earlier, over that period of 2006 and 2016, have varied − more private housing and, therefore, the proportion decreased from 78% of public housing dwelling units to 72%.

sections.label: Commitment to stable affordable public housing
sections.summary: The passage states that projecting demographic trends is very hard, but the commitment is to continue providing stable and affordable public housing for Singaporeans.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: I think it is very hard to project what demographic trends there will be.

sentences.speaker: Mr Lawrence Wong
sentences.text: But our commitment, clearly, is to make sure that we continue to provide stable and affordable public housing for Singaporeans.
